fields.author: Aarav Sharma
fields.quote: Coffee Adda is easily the best cafe in the Budhanilkantha area! Their cappuccino has the silkiest micro-foam and the latte art is top tier. A tranquil oasis to read or work on your laptop.

fields.author: Pooja Thapa
fields.quote: Such a cosy ambiance with plenty of natural greenery and warm wood tables. The iced cold brew with condensed milk on a sunny afternoon is pure heaven. Friendly baristas too!

fields.author: Rohan Karki
fields.quote: Fair prices, superb espresso consistency, and wonderful aesthetic vibes. The pastry was warm and buttery. Highly recommended if you are heading towards Shivapuri or living nearby!
